title: Baked Smoked Salmon & Eggs
description: Smoked salmon and a baked egg nestled inside a crusty roll, finished with butter and chives.
steps: Slice the top from the roll and hollow out enough bread to fit an egg.
Brush the inside with butter, add the salmon, then crack in the egg.
Bake at 180C for 10-15 minutes until the egg is set to your liking, then finish with chives.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food baked salmon & eggs

notes: A great once-a-week treat breakfast — smoked salmon brings omega-3s alongside the egg protein.
